message: My master's program end date was May 15, 2026 and I haven't applied for OPT yet. What is the last day I can file?
reference: File Form I-765 by 2026-06-14, no later than 30 days after the 2026-05-15 program end date.

message: My DSO entered my OPT recommendation in SEVIS on 2026-05-01 and my program ends 2026-05-15. When is my I-765 deadline?
reference: File by 2026-05-31, because the form must be filed within 30 days of the DSO recommendation.

message: I'm on OPT from June 1 2026 to May 31 2027. I worked at Acme from June 1 to August 10, 2026 and have been unemployed since. How many unemployment days do I have left?
reference: 29 of the 90 allowed days of unemployment are used, so 61 are left.

message: My OPT EAD is valid 2026-06-01 through 2027-05-31. My degree is computer science, which is on the STEM list. When can I file for the STEM extension?
reference: From 2027-03-02 to 2027-05-31: up to 90 days before the current OPT authorization expires.

message: My STEM OPT extension was approved. My original OPT ended May 31 2027. I started at Beta Corp on Sept 1 2027 and still work there. When are my validation reports due?
reference: Every six months from the 2027-06-01 start: the first report (reporting date 2027-12-01) is due by 2027-12-15, within 10 business days.

message: My program ended last Friday, that's the end date on my I-20. What is my OPT filing window?
reference: From 2026-02-14 to 2026-06-14: up to 90 days before and no later than 30 days after the program end date.

message: My OPT started 2026-07-01 and ends 2027-06-30. I worked at Gamma from 2026-07-15 to 2026-12-31 and at Delta from 2027-02-01 until now. Am I over the unemployment limit?
reference: No: 45 of the 90 allowed days are used, 45 are left.

message: My degree is in economics, which is not STEM. My OPT ends 2027-05-31. Can I get the STEM extension?
reference: No. The 24-month extension requires a bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree in a DHS-designated STEM field.

message: I'm on an approved STEM OPT extension; my original OPT ended 2027-05-31. I started at Beta on 2027-09-01 and lost that job on 2028-01-31. When must I report it?
reference: Report the loss of employment to the DSO within 10 days, by 2028-02-10.

message: My program end date is 2026-12-18 and my DSO recommended OPT on 2026-11-02. When do I need to file by?
reference: By 2026-12-02, within 30 days of the DSO recommendation (the window opened 2026-09-19).

message: When can I file for OPT if my program ends 2026-08-14?
reference: From 2026-05-16 to 2026-09-13; the window is not open yet.

message: My program ends 2026-12-18. What is the latest OPT start date I can request?
reference: No later than 2027-01-17, 30 days after the program end date.

message: My program ended 2026-05-15. By when must I finish all my post-completion OPT?
reference: By 2027-07-15, within 14 months after completing study (a STEM extension is exempt).

message: My OPT EAD ends 2027-05-31 and I'm not applying for STEM. How long can I stay after it ends?
reference: Until 2027-06-30: 30 days after OPT ends to depart or otherwise maintain status.

message: My STEM OPT extension was approved and my original OPT ended 2027-05-31. When is my 12-month self-evaluation due?
reference: By 2028-06-11, no later than 10 days after the 12-month evaluation period ends.

message: My STEM OPT extension was approved; my first OPT EAD ended 2027-05-31. When does my STEM period end?
reference: It runs from 2027-06-01 to 2029-05-31, 24 months from the day after the first OPT expired.

message: I'm on approved STEM OPT (my original OPT ended 2027-05-31) and started a new job at Zeta on 2028-03-01. When is my new I-983 due?
reference: Submit a new Form I-983 to the DSO within 10 days of starting, by 2028-03-11.

message: My OPT EAD was 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31 and my STEM extension is approved. I worked from 2026-06-01 to 2027-01-31 and again from 2027-04-01 until now. How many unemployment days have I used?
reference: 59 of the 150 allowed days are used, 91 are left.

message: My OPT started 2026-06-01 and ends 2027-05-31. I haven't found any job yet. Am I okay?
reference: No: 102 days of unemployment exceed the 90-day limit for post-completion OPT.

message: My DSO entered my STEM extension recommendation on 2027-03-15. My OPT EAD expires 2027-05-31 and my mechanical engineering degree is on the STEM list. When must I file?
reference: Between 2027-03-02 and 2027-05-14, because the form must be filed within 60 days of the DSO recommendation.

message: How long can I be unemployed during post-completion OPT?
reference: No more than 90 days in aggregate, or 150 days in total with a 24-month STEM extension.

message: Where can I work if I want an on-campus job?
reference: On the school's premises, including on-location firms that serve students such as the bookstore or cafeteria, or at an off-campus location educationally affiliated with the school.

message: What is CPT and who authorizes it?
reference: Curricular practical training is work that is an integral part of an established curriculum, such as a required internship or co-op; the DSO authorizes it.

message: I'm on STEM OPT and moved to a new apartment yesterday. How long do I have to report it?
reference: Report the change of address to the DSO within 10 days of the change.

message: Do I need to tell my DSO if my OPT job is interrupted?
reference: Yes. A student on OPT must report any change of name or address, or interruption of employment, to the DSO.

message: Can I travel abroad while on post-completion OPT and come back to my job?
reference: Yes, with an unexpired OPT EAD and a Form I-20 endorsed for reentry by the DSO within the last six months, if otherwise admissible.

message: My employer cut my STEM OPT pay without changing my hours. What do I need to do?
reference: It is a material change: the student and employer must sign a modified Form I-983 and submit it to the DSO at the earliest opportunity.

message: Can I start working before my OPT card arrives?
reference: No. OPT may not begin before the approved start date on the Employment Authorization Document.

message: How many hours a week must my STEM OPT job be?
reference: At least 20 hours per week.

message: My program ended 2026-05-15. My OPT EAD runs from 2026-06-14 to 2027-06-13 and I've worked at Acme since 2026-07-01. How many unemployment days have I used?
reference: 17 of the 90 allowed days are used, 73 are left.

out_of_scope: H-1B lottery, petition or other work visas
